source_notes: 33 dispatch699cd7 calls6a7ae0; variant11 routes at6a7b81 to4e7250, the same installed controller as818. 826Hardy independently calls4ee860.
Native state16 integrates falling rocks; damping.8 and bounce-.3 on landing, gravity.5, speed<2 and vertical<.6 with1/4 roll start Appear. ANM2 Appear20 at30FPS then state3.

Counter advances1 normally/2 for variants1or2; exact12/24/36 selects heading before a1/2 roll accelerates odd counters. Thus normal selections may be skipped; do not force three turns per cycle. Reset at48 after last impulse.

Ordinary normal chase5/6, coal/tinted3/4; chase uses pathfinding for blocked line and spread+-15degrees; wander picks up to10 directions tested20 units out. Force3 normal,5.1 tinted,5.4 coal except Singe907-spawned coal4.8.
Normal death4e8173 morphs the same entity85 and restores fullHP; does not spawn independently. Occupied-grid death suppresses normal morph and coal offspring.
Coal death4e80c7 creates33.11 with same subtype, half XY velocity, height-1 and vertical[-2,-1]. Hot coal stays in16; does not awaken.

Hot coal HP15 manual damage: <=10source hit causes1or2 wear; larger causes2or3;1/3 chance for extra wear. Explosion/crush forcesHP1/death. Native fire flags are removed after manual wear, so a delivered positive flame hit still causes bounded coal wear, unlike flame-immune Coal Spider.

Coal applies a2/3 one-damage event every30 sourceframes. The Fireplace wrapper adds a one-damage event every5frames in water>0.2. Each event passes through manual wear. Population empty with early clear timer removes coal.
Subtype0 selects1..3 using sourceInitSeed%3+1. DeathWard uses its seeded encounter RNG; no RNG-stream parity claimed.
Wiki Rock Spider revision270019 supplies descriptive habitat, stomp and tinted-rock/soul-heart production context. Repentance+Hagalaz behavior is excluded from this1.7.9b baseline.

Hardy source/animation metadata is preserved here as the next dependency consumer; its full controller contract and implementation are still pending. Tinted Rock Spider requires actual soul-heart resource behavior and tinted-rock production, so is not enabled by this batch.
